answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 46349 Country: India Title: Dua Question: Our family is working hard but we are not getting good profit. Please tell us supplication for our business (hotel) to grow and to remove our poverty. Answer ID: 46349 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1114/863/B=1434) Recite the following dua 100-100 times in the morning and evening: اللهم اكفنى بحلالك عن حرامك واغننى بفضلك عمن سواك . Or read بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم 100-100 times in the morning and evening. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
